archive.record_filter: Only root task7/bXX_{off|on}.{events,results,manifest} files; exclude task7/failed_attempts; SQLite evaluations filtered by the 44 accepted ON turn_ids

caveats: Archive snapshot and repository commit were not generated atomically; record association is based on user-provided revision and frozen manifest hashes.
Bootstrap confidence intervals are implementation- and seed-dependent; do not claim numerical identity with previous runs using a different resampling seed.
The observed OFF/ON associations do not establish causality or equivalence; output lengths and shared GPU resource conditions may confound completion latency.
Task 7 used typed questions and does not assess microphone/STT latency.
No independent human judge validity labels were collected.
